content:
ivy: New user hit a weird onboarding flow. Followed the Rust quickstart, exported REDWOOD_KEY, but first API POST returns 402 even though UI shows trial active. Anyone seen this timing mismatch?

omar: Was the org created by invite or SSO?

ivy: Invite link. I used the starter binary on Linux. Quick curl below.

ivy: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace payment required","billing_url":"https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/xyz/billing"}}
```

kat: Two common causes: (1) frontend toggles onboarding state early, (2) sample uses fallback config file instead of env so it might be sending an old key.

ivy: I grepped the process env; REDWOOD_KEY is there. But the starter prints a masked key source as "file" in logs. Turns out systemd unit for the starter loads /etc/redwood/config.toml and overrides.

omar: Ah — config precedence bug. Starter should prefer env var and log the exact source. Also what SDK version? Retries could be spamming gateway.

ivy: Rust SDK 0.8.0. Starter's client is configured with default retries; I saw 5 POSTs back-to-back in my app logs and the webhooks showed multiple 402s.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-114 created: onboarding-billing-preflight-and-retry-loop  https://go.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-114

kat: Quick fixes: (A) change starter to prefer env > unit > file and print masked source; (B) add a preflight GET /v1/workspaces/me and wait for state=="active" for up to 60s; (C) set SDK to not retry on 4xx billing_required.

ivy: I patched my local unit to remove the file override and re-exported REDWOOD_KEY; first request works now after ~25s. I'll open PR for the starter to prefer env and add a small spinner.

starter-bot: Issue opened: redwood-inference/starter#744  "rust: prefer env REDWOOD_KEY over config file/systemd + show source log"

sdk-bot: SDK issue created: SDK-512 "Do not retry on 402 billing_required; add helper wait_for_workspace_ready"

omar: Long-term: SDKs should include a helper that wraps the preflight poll and an easy opt-in to treat billing_required as terminal. We'll add to the SDK roadmap.

ivy: Thanks, folks. PR incoming for the spinner + env precedence. Closing unless it reappears. :sparkles:
